architecture.pattern: Monolith with Redis cache layer (stepping stone to microservices)
architecture.rationale: Phase 3 microservices decomposition requires significant refactoring of NestJS monolith. Redis caching provides immediate performance gains while architecture evolves.

transition_plan.step2: Extract Redis service into standalone @udb/cache package
transition_plan.step3: Split auth service into independent microservice
transition_plan.step4: Split planning service into independent microservice

services.name: Redis Cache Layer
services.failover: In-memory Map fallback when Redis unavailable
